samples.about: A three-storey corner block assembled at runtime and dressed with the Blender kit, with the cutaway modes: walls up, cut, down, storey by storey.

samples.title: Animation library (Mixamo)
samples.about: Mixamo clips fitted once to MPFB's mixamo skeleton (tools/blender/animlib.py) and re-based onto any person on that skeleton (samples/lib/anim.js). Only the walk so far: the rest await Chrome's permission for multiple downloads.

samples.title: Looks: cartoonish 3D iso
samples.about: The same street (the corner block, a walker, a man upstairs) rendered several ways. pixel: 3D pixel art, low resolution, outlines, toon light. toon: flat colours, three light bands, outlines. flat: a low-poly toy. chibi: heads 1.5 times. Realistic stays one option among these.

samples.title: Chibi town: pixel art from simple 3D
samples.about: A handheld-RPG look: 480 × 270, a camera straight on and 45° down so a metre is 16 px on the ground and up a wall, one palette, inked outlines. People are pixel sprites drawn from templates in three views and shaded like a pixel artist (samples/lib/sprites.js), stood in the street as upright cards, 8 frames a second. Trees and props are sprites too (samples/lib/townsprites.js); facades, signs and the ground are painted textures on boxes (samples/lib/pixeltown.js). Night lights the windows, signs and lamps.

samples.title: Fine town: sample 006's street in a finer finish
samples.about: After Stoneshard (the user's reference): the same street as sample 006, at 640 × 360 (more of it on screen, as Stoneshard shows), in a finer finish. People are drawn finer (samples/lib/finepeople.js): a 24 × 40 cell, faces with eyes, brows, cheeks and a mouth, legs and boots that show, six hue-shifted tones a colour, outlines softened on the lit side, limbs from joints so the walk has 8 frames, the run 6, and idle breathes and blinks. Surfaces are bevelled brick by brick and slab by slab, plaster weathered down to the brick in places, ivy, puddles, weeds, litter; a 116-colour warm palette and a warm grade. Measured on Stoneshard's screenshots, its people are 2.4 heads tall: close to our chibi; the difference is the finish.
